entries.description: Contains 281 cropped JPEG images and object-label JSON across four ZIP archives. No camera intrinsics, camera poses, COLMAP model or 3D geometry is supplied, so this source cannot be loaded in ColmapView.

facts.label: Check performed
facts.value: Enumerated every file in the complete ZIP central directories for all four archives, and inspected the summary and all four object-label manifests. No image previews were created.

facts.label: office2_gt_crops.zip
facts.value: 61 JPEG crops and labels.json; no other files.

facts.label: Label contents
facts.value: Object classes, instance IDs, crop filenames and frame indices. Point-count fields contain counts, not 3D point coordinates. No camera calibration or poses are included.
